message.content:
The probability that Dan wins president is \( \frac12 \), and the probability that Freddie wins vice president is \( \frac12 \). Assuming the two elections are independent,

\[
P(\text{Dan and Freddie win})=\frac12 \cdot \frac12=\frac14.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac14}
\]
